title: demolish_apply_tick uses floor+1 while sibling draw/spawn use floor; its comment claims 'same as a draw'
detail: Comment says 'same as a draw', but the body is draw's formula + 1. Draw and spawn use plain floor. So demolish fires one tick later than an equally-logged draw at the same ms — the asymmetry is undocumented.
recommended_fix: Either remove the +1 so demolish truly matches draw (as the comment claims), or rewrite the comment to state the real reason demolish intentionally applies one tick later than draw.
